headline: Callahans Passage Flares Anew as Fishermans Row Flags Keep Turning
war_summary: Since the last edition, the long-quiet guns of Callahans Passage have roared back to life: hourly losses on that field now run near a thousand men to each side, though all ten works remain in Warden keeping after Crumbling Post's earlier convulsions. The Nevish Line, still these many days hushed, likewise stirs, logging close to two thousand Colonial losses in a day. Fishermans Row remains the busiest post of the war, with fifty-seven flag events behind it; the vacant ground there has been restored to Warden keeping, leaving three Warden works against six Colonial, the last change logged at this edition's very minute. Stlican Shelf churns on, thirty-six events deep, its balance shifted to five Warden, three Colonial, and one ruin. Weathered Expanse, costliest field of all with roughly 13,600 Colonial and 16,700 Warden losses in the day, has fallen oddly still in recent hours, its five-to-four count unchanged. Farranac Coast wakes about The Bone Haft, Linn of Mercy's Lathair revolves without cease, and Mooring County and Stonecradle have cooled for now. Day 281; no victor declared.
